plan.major: Aeronautical & Aviation Technology - General Aircraft Maintenance
plan.notes: Degree requirements: [1] 60 semester units; [2] 18 units in the major; [3] 21 units AVC GE; [4] 2.0 GPA; [5] C or better in major courses. Major = AERO120 (7.5) + AERO121 (7.5) + Program Elective 3-8 units = 18-23 units. AERO 120/121 offered Summer only. The guide prints 22 AVC GE units in the pathway against the 21-unit minimum; transcribed as printed. Rev. 7/8/25, 10/14/25, 1/27/26 (Angie Gonzalez).
